login.title: Welcome back
login.description: Log in to see your library, wishlist and orders.
login.legal: By logging in you agree to the <terms>Terms of Service</terms> and <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.
login.cartNote_one: Your cart ({{count}} item) will be kept when you log in.
login.cartNote_other: Your cart ({{count}} items) will be kept when you log in.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Free, and it takes about a minute.
register.cartNote_one: Your cart ({{count}} item) will be saved to your new account.
register.cartNote_other: Your cart ({{count}} items) will be saved to your new account.

strength.label: Password strength: {{level}}
strength.tip: Tip: a few random words work well

register.newsletter: Send me news and offers by email
register.newsletterHint: Optional. You can unsubscribe at any time.
register.legal: By creating an account you agree to the <terms>Terms of Service</terms> and <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

summary.password: Use at least 10 characters for the password

errors.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists. <login>Log in instead</login> or <reset>reset your password</reset>.
errors.rateLimited_one: Too many attempts. Try again in {{count}} second.
errors.rateLimited_other: Too many attempts. Try again in {{count}} seconds.
errors.serverTitle: Something went wrong on our side
errors.serverBody: We could not create your account. Nothing you typed was lost.

why.title: Your tabletop library, wherever you play

library.title: Your library on every device
library.body: Download your PDFs again at any time and get notified when files are updated.

wishlist.title: Wishlist with price drops
wishlist.body: Save titles and we tell you when one goes on sale.

follow.title: Follow your publishers
follow.body: New releases from the studios you like, in one feed.

checkout.title: Faster checkout
checkout.body: Saved addresses and cards for the next order.

gifts.title: Claim gifts and certificates
gifts.body: Redeem a gift code or a gift certificate straight into your account.

why.trust: We never share your email. You can still check out as a guest if you prefer.

success.title: Welcome to DriveThruRPG
success.subtitle: Your account is ready and you are logged in.
success.mail:
We sent a confirmation link to
{{email}}
Confirm it so you can always get back into your library.
success.cartSaved_one: {{count}} item from your cart was saved to your account.
success.cartSaved_other: {{count}} items from your cart were saved to your account.
success.sent: We sent the confirmation email again.
success.emailChanged: We sent a confirmation link to {{email}}.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.subtitle: Enter the email you signed up with and we will send you a link to choose a new one.
forgot.socialNote: Signed up with Google, Facebook or Roll20? You do not have a password, just use that button to log in.
forgot.rateLimited_one: Too many requests. You can try again in {{count}} second.
forgot.rateLimited_other: Too many requests. You can try again in {{count}} seconds.

sent.title: Check your email
sent.subtitle: If an account exists for {{email}}, we have sent a link to reset your password. The link works once and expires in 1 hour.
sent.tipSpam: Look in spam, promotions or other tabs.
sent.tipAddress: Make sure the address is the one you signed up with.
sent.tipSocial: If you signed up with Google, Facebook or Roll20, log in with that button instead.
sent.resent: Another email is on its way.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.subtitle: Choose something you have not used on this site before.
reset.note: This link can be used once. After you save, we sign you out on all other devices.

expired.title: This link has expired
expired.subtitle: Reset links work once and for 1 hour. This one was already used or is too old. It happens, we can send you a new one.

done.title: Password updated
done.subtitle: You can now log in with your new password. For your safety we signed you out on all other devices.
done.notYou: We sent a notice to your email address. If you did not ask for this, <support>contact support</support> right away.
